function.name: give_up
function.arguments: {"reason": "The red block stays on the table near x=-0.04, y=-0.055; the blue bowl is near x=0.028, y=0.026. Four gripper closures from verified straddling poses all ended fully closed (measured 0.016) with the block outside the jaws, so no grasp could be secured and the block was never transported. With one decision left and no held object, the task cannot be completed within this trial.", "hindsight": "1) Move interpolation budget tracks the commanded gripper delta (~80 steps per 1.0 delta); arm-only or repeat gripper targets get 1-5 steps, so pair arm motion with a changed gripper target (0.6 retains the previous open/closed latch while giving budget). 2) The TCP reference sits about 5cm above the fingertip pads: grasp at TCP z~0.866-0.873 puts pads at mid/lower block (block spans z 0.80-0.84). 3) Repeated symmetric closes from above kept ejecting the 4cm block -Y; verify a hold by the measured opening staying mid-range (a full close reads ~0.016). 4) Near-base folded poses (x~-0.04) saturate the wrist joint and slow descents; the bowl area near x=0.03 is more comfortable. 5) Scene: bowl near (0.028, 0.026), table z=0.80, wrist camera image-right is roughly world -y and its view is tilted, so image center is not the TCP."}
